test_robotiq_2f85_physics_step: test the Robotiq2F85 gripper physics step by creating an MJCF model and stepping simulation
test_robotiq_2f85_ctrlrange: test the Robotiq2F85 gripper actuator control range is between -255.0 and 255.0
test_robotiq_2f85_action_spec: test the Robotiq2F85 gripper action spec minimum and maximum values in a composer environment
test_robotiq_2f85_grasp_open_close: test the Robotiq2F85 gripper fully opens to position 0 and fully closes to position 255
test_robotiq_2f85_actuation_clipping: test the Robotiq2F85 gripper actuator state clipping when actuation exceeds control range bounds
